Name: Linus the Fox
Author: jembit
Description:
New additions include winter sprites and an extra line of dialogue for winter. I didn't change anything else, because I think his dialogue suits him.
Now compatible with 1.6.

Credit to cat9412 on the Chucklefish Community Forums for turning the sprites into a mod that can be used with Content Patcher. Linus's folder goes into SMAPI's Mods folder with Content Patcher.

Manifest.Name: Linus the Fox
Manifest.Description: Turns Linus into a little fox that sometimes forgets he's a quadruped.
